name: C5-1 A trajectory as state, action and reward tensors
description: Prints one episode: states, actions, rewards, return

params.label: Action sequence (4 ints, one per step)

data.noteContent:
Reinforcement learning is written in terms of a state, an action and a reward, and this graph is those three as tensors you can read: four timesteps of a six-feature observation, the action taken at each step, and the reward that followed it. Nothing is learned and no environment runs; this is the shape of the data the rest of C5 is written against. After a run the Prints hold the three tensors and the return, 0.35. For the real thing, EnvWrapper builds an environment and PolicyRollout runs a policy inside it, handing out these same three tensors.

強化學習是用狀態、動作、獎勵這三樣東西寫出來的，這張圖把它們攤成讀得懂的張量：四個時間步、每步六維觀測，每一步採取的動作，以及隨之而來的獎勵。這裡沒有學習，也沒有真的環境在跑；它給的是 C5 後面各節共用的資料形狀。跑完之後，Print 分別是三個張量與回報 0.35。要換成真的，EnvWrapper 負責建環境，PolicyRollout 讓策略在裡面跑，輸出的就是同樣這三個張量。

The Mean node averages the four rewards, so the return printed here is 0.35 and not their sum, 1.4. An average stays comparable between episodes of different lengths. A textbook return is usually the discounted sum instead, which is what the Discount node computes.

Mean 把四個獎勵取平均，所以這裡印出的回報是 0.35，不是總和 1.4。取平均的好處是不同長度的回合之間還能互相比較。課本裡的回報通常是折扣後的總和，那是 Discount 節點做的事。
